messages:
maria: proposing a safe rollout pattern for 'lockbox' config changes (route weights + quota). want preview -> deterministic cohort -> staged commit with auto-revert.

alex: +1. keep the preview metadata minimal: preview_id, owner, sample_rate, scope. also add edit_lock during promotion.

maria: draft payload: {preview_id: lb-6140, owner: maria, sample_rate: 0.02, scope: {hash_prefix: 8}}. start 2% sampled dry-run.

jess: telemetry needs preview_id tag on logs/metrics/traces. dashboards should show preview vs baseline delta and a volume floor. avoid paging on noisy small samples.

sam: suggest thresholds: min_volume=400 over 20m, p95_delta <= 18% relative, err_delta <= 0.6pp, cost_delta <= 25%. if breached auto-revert.

alex: implement two alert classes: signal-breach (alerts on breach) and low-volume (notify only).

maria: runbook: 1) create preview lb-6140 2) wait for floor or 30m 3) if ok, promote to enforced deterministic cohort (10 tenants) for 30m 4) if ok, staged commits 10->30->60% over 90m. include edit_lock during promote.

jess: UI: show small preview badge, owner, preview_id, promote/abort buttons. show rolling median and delta panels.

ops-bot: smoke test for lb-6140: 800 synthetic reqs -> p95 +5%, err +0.04pp, cost +7%. no auto-revert.

maria: scheduling 14:00 PT. tagging @sre-oncall separately. will attach preview_id to incident channel when we start.

alex: one more: add meta.tag so we can filter in console: meta.tag=lockbox-cost-check

maria: added. thanks team.
